# S38 — Dashboard cards: status line, streak line, stable order, no no-op chips

**Findings:** TrackerDao.kt:14 (order by updatedAt); MainScreen.kt:277-343 (marketing header, no-op AssistChips, completion bar always shown) · **Size:** M · **Tree:** ui

**Not in this slice:** the one-tap buttons and undo (S39), string resources (S18), accessibility semantics (S45). Keep the existing "Quick log" button as it is until S39 replaces it.

## Why

- The order is `updatedAtEpochMs DESC`, so every log moves that card to the top and the list reshuffles under the thumb.
- Nothing says what is done today or what is left.
- "Recent completion 0%" and its bar show for trackers with no target.
- The header copy wastes the first screen, and the `AssistChip(onClick = {})` elements are focusable buttons that do nothing.
- The last card is hidden behind the FAB, and `EmptyState` ignores the Scaffold padding.

## Files

- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/TrackerDao.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ui/DashboardScreen.kt` (or `MainScreen.kt` if S32 has not landed)
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ui/Components.kt` (`EmptyState`, new `StatusLine` and `StreakLine`)
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ui/TrackerDetailScreen.kt` (header) and `MainScreen.kt` (top-bar title)

## Failing tests

- None on the JVM (layout work). The data fields it reads are tested in S13.

## Implement

1. DAO: change the dashboard query to `ORDER BY isArchived ASC, createdAtEpochMs ASC, id ASC` so the order is stable.
2. Delete the header `item { ... }` with the marketing copy. Replace the empty state text with "No trackers yet." and a `Button("Create tracker")` that opens the new-tracker dialog (pass an `onCreate` lambda).
3. Rebuild `TrackerSummaryCard` from the S13 fields, in this order:
   - Title row: emoji and name (keep the existing "Quick log" button for non-MEASURE trackers).
   - Status line (`bodyMedium`):
     - YES_NO: "Done today" or "Not logged today". With a weekly target, append " · {periodValue} / {periodTarget} this week".
     - COUNT with a daily target: "{todayValue} / {target} {unit} today". With a weekly target: "{periodValue} / {target} {unit} this week". With no target: "{todayValue} {unit} today".
     - MEASURE: "Last: {date}" or "Not logged yet".
   - Streak line, only when the tracker has a target: "{n}-day streak · best {m}" ("week" for weekly targets). With a streak of zero: "No streak yet · best {m}".
   - Completion bar and a "Last 14 days: 71%" / "Last 8 weeks: 50%" label, only when `completionRate != null`.
   - Reminder label as plain text (keep S09's warning marker if it has landed).
3a. Write the status line and the streak line as two composables in `ui/Components.kt`, `StatusLine(summary: TrackerSummary)` and `StreakLine(summary: TrackerSummary)`, and use them in the card.
4. Remove `MetricChip`, the target `AssistChip`, and the "Last entry" and "Recent completion" lines. `MetricChip` is also used by the detail header (`TrackerDetailScreen`, "Current streak" and "Longest"), so update it in this slice too: replace its chip row with `StatusLine(detail.summary)` and `StreakLine(detail.summary)`, keep the description, target and reminder text, and keep the "Log entry" and "Archive" buttons as they are (S15 moves Archive). Then delete `MetricChip`.
4a. The top-bar title on the detail screen shows the tracker (emoji and name) instead of "Tracker", on one line with `maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis`. While the detail is loading, show an empty title.
5. Colour: a card with `doneToday == true` uses `CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant)`. Do not reorder done cards.
6. Dates use `DateTimeFormatter.ofLocalizedDate(FormatStyle.MEDIUM)`, and numbers use `NumberRules.formatNumber` (S33).
7. Give the dashboard `LazyColumn` `contentPadding = PaddingValues(16.dp, 16.dp, 16.dp, 88.dp)` so the FAB never covers the last card. Make `EmptyState` accept and apply the Scaffold `padding`.

## Check

- Manual: log a tracker and the card order does not change. A tracker with no target shows no completion bar. The last card is fully visible above the FAB.
- `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` passes.
